subject: Social Media
title: Persuasive Design
description: A quick, practical guide to Persuasive Design.

hook.text: Every pixel on your screen was placed to keep you there. Nothing in an app is accidental.

buildup.text: B.J. Fogg at Stanford trained a generation of designers in persuasive technology—shaping behavior through design.

discovery.text: His behavior model: behavior = motivation × ability × trigger. Apps maximize all three simultaneously.

twist.text: Fogg's students built Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms. He later questioned what he'd unleashed.

climax.text: Tristan Harris, his former student, became Big Tech's loudest critic. The teacher's best pupil turned rebel.

punchline.text: They learned to change behavior. Then they did.

quiz.question: What did B.J. Fogg teach designers?
